title: MZ Looking for a very specific plugin for a custom menu

posts.author: Perkaholic_
posts.body:
Hello all! I'm kinda new to the forum, but I was looking for someone to help me create a plugin for MZ for not only a custom looking menu, but also custom functioning.
For context and more explanation, in my game I'd like the player's phone to act as the menu. Therefore, the menu can't even be accessed until the player picks up the phone item. Once they do, the menu will open and display the custom menu layout and art. It would be stylized like a modern smart phone, with the buttons looking like apps and working as such. Settings would open the game's actual settings (i.e - graphics, audio, controls...), the messaging app would display messages from characters (possibly making it so the player can choose certain text responses to send back), the actual phone app would work similarly, but rather be played out more like a cutscene, checking on your character's stats/status could either be a camera app (to display the status visually) or an actual health app and the notes or reminder app would show you the current task or tasks that could be done at the time.
I currently have almost all of the VisuStella plugins (I bought the 8 wave pack as I have used many of the plugins in other mini games), but I only have a few installed currently (see attached).
I'm not sure if this is even possible for MZ and I'm honestly not even sure how to approach it if it possible. I would love any and all advice, as I'm not a programmer, I'm merely an artist!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can do this without a plugin through events:
Eventing a Picture-Based Menu | The Official RPG Maker Blog
The default RPG Maker menu works well, but sometimes you want one that fits your game’s aesthetic better or offers only the important options. Eventing your own picture-based menu is a great way to make sure your menu fits your game, so let’s take a look at how to make one.
www.rpgmakerweb.com
Or you can Google "RPG Maker MZ phone menu" (don't know how compatible it is with VisuStella materials):
Phone Menu [MZ, MV] – KageDesu Workshop
kdworkshop.net
